description: Database validation queries for your JSON request

validation_queries.purpose: Check if child exists and has phone number
validation_queries.query: SELECT id, childName, phoneNo FROM children WHERE id = 3;
SELECT id, name FROM health_care_providers WHERE id = 2;

validation_queries.purpose: Check if vaccination codes exist and are available
validation_queries.query: SELECT vaccination_code, Hali, vaccination_no FROM vaccinations WHERE vaccination_code IN ('BCG', 'bOPVO') AND Hali = 'inasubiri' AND vaccination_no IS NULL;
SELECT vaccination_no, COUNT(*) as usage_count FROM vaccinations WHERE vaccination_no = 'VAC-8080' GROUP BY vaccination_no;

validation_queries.purpose: Check if vaccination number is assigned to different codes
validation_queries.query: SELECT vaccination_no, vaccination_code FROM vaccinations WHERE vaccination_no = 'VAC-8080';

expected_results.should_return: 2 rows (BCG and bOPVO) with Hali='inasubiri' and vaccination_no=NULL
Either no rows or rows with same vaccination codes you're using
